stations.title: Store sheet
stations.text: Kit signed out and never crossed off.

captions: Back at the base, Rhona asks Dougie how many ropes are in the store.
Today the sheet is out of date, because kit goes out and nobody crosses it off.
You keep the store as a dictionary and look up, change and count kit by name.
Now the count for ropes is right, and it changes as kit goes out.
Dictionaries, get, del, items, counting, and a list of records.
